title: ID0419365-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/10]CCS connector issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: There is a problem on the CCS cable of this charger (CCS1, cable at the right of the charger). Indeed, we can see that one DC+ pin blade is burnt which can cause overheating problems. Can you plan an intervention with the french team please to change the CCS connector
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: N/A
